name: inbound-webhook-bridge
description: Receives signed external webhooks, verifies them server-side, and dispatches them as payment-document actions.

config.name: WEBHOOK_SIGNING_SECRET
config.description: Shared HMAC-SHA256 secret used to verify the `x-webhook-signature` header on inbound requests. Read only on the server (in webhook-bridge.ts); it must never be bundled for or shipped to the browser. Obtain it from the provider's webhook settings (e.g. Stripe's signing secret).
